media.alt_caption: A clay barn floating in a bright sky

steps.title: Hello from TeeBot
steps.prompt: Hey there! TeeBot is so happy to see you today. Are you ready to explore?

steps.title: Warm-Up
steps.prompt: Do you remember how to say hello? Wave and say "Hello, TeeBot!"

steps.title: New Words
steps.prompt: Today we are visiting a barn! A barn is a big house for farm animals. We will also learn "farm" and "hay."
steps.helperText: Look at the picture and listen.

steps.title: TeeBot Shows You
steps.prompt: This is a barn. Watch my mouth: "barn." Make a strong /b/ sound and keep the /n/ at the end!
steps.helperText: Look at the barn and make a strong /b/ sound.

steps.title: Listen Carefully
steps.prompt: Listen to "barn" one more time. Hear the ending sound? b-a-r-n.

steps.title: Your Barn Word
steps.helperText: Short and strong: barn. Say the ending sound clearly!
steps.l1TransferHint: In Vietnamese we say "chuồng," but in English we must say the whole word "barn" - don't drop the ending /n/ sound!

steps.title: Great Listening!
steps.prompt: Wonderful! Remember: in English, every word needs its ending sound. "Barn" has a strong /n/ at the end. You did it!

steps.title: Barn Star!
steps.prompt: You found the barn with TeeBot! Look how your garden is growing!
steps.parentSummary: Today your child practiced place words (barn, farm, hay) and worked on final consonants - a common challenge for Vietnamese learners. Try asking "What is this?" while looking at farm picture books.

sourceReferences.title: Oxford Phonics World - Sample Pages

vietnameseRelevance.notes: Phonics sequence addresses Vietnamese final consonant deletion.

sourceReferences.takeaway: Use 4-step spiral: warm-up -> model -> practice -> review. Focus on final consonant awareness.
sourceReferences.limitations: No Vietnamese L1 support. English-only audio. Requires adaptation for stress patterns.
